description: This file defines types and a parser function for handling configuration commands in a chat or CLI application. It specifies different command actions such as 'show', 'set', 'unset', and 'error', and provides a function to parse raw command strings into these structured commands.

methods.name: export function parseConfigCommand(raw: string): ConfigCommand | null { parseConfigCommand
methods.description: Parses a raw command string into a ConfigCommand object or returns null if invalid. Uses a standard parsing function and customizes the behavior based on command action.
